# Quest Tracking System (Godot 4)

Build a data-driven quest tracking system in the Godot 4 project at
`/home/user/quest_project`. The headless `godot` binary (Godot 4) is
already on `PATH`.

## Criteria

- Custom `Resource` `scripts/QuestObjective.gd` (`class_name
  QuestObjective`) with `@export`s `description: String`, `target_count:
  int`, `current_count: int` (default `0`) and method `is_complete() ->
  bool`.
- Custom `Resource` `scripts/Quest.gd` (`class_name Quest`) with
  `@export`s `id: StringName`, `title: String`, `description: String`,
  `objectives: Array[QuestObjective]`,
  `prerequisite_quest_ids: Array[StringName]`, `reward_gold: int`,
  `reward_items: Array[StringName]`, and methods `is_complete() -> bool`
  and `get_progress() -> float` (range `0.0`..`1.0`).
- Three `.tres` quests under `resources/quests/`: `quest_a.tres`,
  `quest_b.tres` (prerequisite: `quest_a`), `quest_c.tres` (prerequisite:
  `quest_b`). Each quest must contain at least one objective.
- Autoload `QuestManager` registered in `project.godot` as
  `res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd`, exposing:
  - `register_quest(quest: Quest)`
  - `can_start(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` (true iff every
    prerequisite is in `completed_ids`)
  - `start_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` (fails if `can_start` is
    false; otherwise emits `quest_started(id)`)
  - `report_progress(objective_key: StringName, amount: int = 1)` — for
    every active quest, increments `current_count` on each objective
    whose `description` (as `StringName`) matches `objective_key`, capped
    at `target_count`; emits `quest_progress(id, progress)`.
  - `complete_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — succeeds only when
    `quest.is_complete()`; on success emits `quest_completed(id,
    reward_gold, reward_items)` and records the quest in `completed_ids`.
  - Signals: `quest_started(id)`, `quest_progress(id, progress)`,
    `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)`.

Verification injects a harness scene into the project and runs `godot
--headless --path /home/user/quest_project res://__verify__/run.tscn`.

Let me break down the task:

1. Create a Godot 4 project at `/home/user/quest_project`
2. Create `QuestObjective` resource class
3. Create `Quest` resource class
4. Create three `.tres` quest resources
5. Create `QuestManager` autoload
6. Register the autoload in `project.godot`

Let me plan this out carefully and then implement it step by step.

Let me first check if the project directory already exists.

Built a complete data-driven quest tracking system in the Godot 4 project at `/home/user/quest_project`. Here's what was created:

### Scripts

**`scripts/QuestObjective.gd`** — `class_name QuestObjective extends Resource`
- `@export var description: String`, `@export var target_count: int`, `@export var current_count: int = 0`
- `is_complete() -> bool` returns `current_count >= target_count`

**`scripts/Quest.gd`** — `class_name Quest extends Resource`
- `@export var id: StringName`, `title: String`, `description: String`, `objectives: Array[QuestObjective]`, `prerequisite_quest_ids: Array[StringName]`, `reward_gold: int`, `reward_items: Array[StringName]`
- `is_complete() -> bool` checks all objectives
- `get_progress() -> float` returns 0.0–1.0 based on objective completion ratios

**`autoloads/QuestManager.gd`** — Autoload (extends Node)
- `register_quest(quest: Quest)` — stores quest by id
- `can_start(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — true iff all prerequisites are in `completed_ids`
- `start_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — fails if can't start; emits `quest_started(id)`
- `report_progress(objective_key: StringName, amount: int = 1)` — increments matching objectives (capped at `target_count`); emits `quest_progress(id, progress)`
- `complete_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — succeeds only when `quest.is_complete()`; emits `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)` and records in `completed_ids`
- Signals: `quest_started(id)`, `quest_progress(id, progress)`, `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)`

### Quest Resources (`resources/quests/`)

| File | ID | Prerequisites | Objectives | Reward |
|------|----|---------------|------------|--------|
| `quest_a.tres` | `quest_a` | None | "Collect 5 herbs" (5) | 100 gold |
| `quest_b.tres` | `quest_b` | `quest_a` | "Defeat 3 wolves" (3) | 200 gold, iron_sword |
| `quest_c.tres` | `quest_c` | `quest_b` | "Defeat the dragon" (1), "Retrieve the treasure" (1) | 500 gold, dragon_scale, golden_crown |

### Configuration

**`project.godot`** — registers `QuestManager` as an autoload singleton pointing to `res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd`.

All scripts were validated via a headless test run confirming: quest loading, prerequisite chains, start/progress/complete lifecycle, signal emissions, and capping behavior.

@tool
extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	# Create quest_a
	var obj_a := QuestObjective.new()
	obj_a.description = "Collect 5 herbs"
	obj_a.target_count = 5
	obj_a.current_count = 0

	var quest_a := Quest.new()
	quest_a.id = &"quest_a"
	quest_a.title = "Gather Herbs"
	quest_a.description = "Collect herbs in the forest"
	quest_a.objectives = [obj_a]
	quest_a.prerequisite_quest_ids = []
	quest_a.reward_gold = 100
	quest_a.reward_items = []

	var err_a := ResourceSaver.save(quest_a, "res://resources/quests/quest_a.tres")
	print("quest_a saved: ", err_a)

	# Create quest_b (prerequisite: quest_a)
	var obj_b := QuestObjective.new()
	obj_b.description = "Defeat 3 wolves"
	obj_b.target_count = 3
	obj_b.current_count = 0

	var quest_b := Quest.new()
	quest_b.id = &"quest_b"
	quest_b.title = "Wolf Hunt"
	quest_b.description = "Hunt the wolves threatening the village"
	quest_b.objectives = [obj_b]
	quest_b.prerequisite_quest_ids = [&"quest_a"]
	quest_b.reward_gold = 200
	quest_b.reward_items = [&"iron_sword"]

	var err_b := ResourceSaver.save(quest_b, "res://resources/quests/quest_b.tres")
	print("quest_b saved: ", err_b)

	# Create quest_c (prerequisite: quest_b)
	var obj_c1 := QuestObjective.new()
	obj_c1.description = "Defeat the dragon"
	obj_c1.target_count = 1
	obj_c1.current_count = 0

	var obj_c2 := QuestObjective.new()
	obj_c2.description = "Retrieve the treasure"
	obj_c2.target_count = 1
	obj_c2.current_count = 0

	var quest_c := Quest.new()
	quest_c.id = &"quest_c"
	quest_c.title = "Dragon Slayer"
	quest_c.description = "Slay the dragon and claim its treasure"
	quest_c.objectives = [obj_c1, obj_c2]
	quest_c.prerequisite_quest_ids = [&"quest_b"]
	quest_c.reward_gold = 500
	quest_c.reward_items = [&"dragon_scale", &"golden_crown"]

	var err_c := ResourceSaver.save(quest_c, "res://resources/quests/quest_c.tres")
	print("quest_c saved: ", err_c)

	quit()

@tool
extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	var passed := true

	# Load quests
	var quest_a: Quest = load("res://resources/quests/quest_a.tres")
	var quest_b: Quest = load("res://resources/quests/quest_b.tres")
	var quest_c: Quest = load("res://resources/quests/quest_c.tres")

	# Verify quest properties
	assert(quest_a.id == &"quest_a", "quest_a id mismatch")
	assert(quest_a.title == "Gather Herbs", "quest_a title mismatch")
	assert(quest_a.objectives.size() == 1, "quest_a should have 1 objective")
	assert(quest_a.prerequisite_quest_ids.is_empty(), "quest_a should have no prerequisites")
	assert(quest_a.reward_gold == 100, "quest_a reward_gold mismatch")

	assert(quest_b.id == &"quest_b", "quest_b id mismatch")

Built a complete data-driven quest tracking system in the Godot 4 project at `/home/user/quest_project`. All components verified via headless test run.

### Files Created

**`scripts/QuestObjective.gd`** — `class_name QuestObjective extends Resource`
- `@export var description: String`, `@export var target_count: int`, `@export var current_count: int = 0`
- `is_complete() -> bool` returns `current_count >= target_count`

**`scripts/Quest.gd`** — `class_name Quest extends Resource`
- `@export var id: StringName`, `title: String`, `description: String`, `objectives: Array[QuestObjective]`, `prerequisite_quest_ids: Array[StringName]`, `reward_gold: int`, `reward_items: Array[StringName]`
- `is_complete() -> bool` checks all objectives are complete
- `get_progress() -> float` returns 0.0–1.0 based on objective completion ratios

**`autoloads/QuestManager.gd`** — Autoload (extends Node)
- `register_quest(quest: Quest)` — stores quest by id
- `can_start(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — true iff all prerequisites are in `completed_ids`
- `start_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — fails if can't start; emits `quest_started(id)`
- `report_progress(objective_key: StringName, amount: int = 1)` — increments matching objectives (capped at `target_count`); emits `quest_progress(id, progress)`
- `complete_quest(quest_id: StringName) -> bool` — succeeds only when `quest.is_complete()`; emits `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)` and records in `completed_ids`
- Signals: `quest_started(id)`, `quest_progress(id, progress)`, `quest_completed(id, reward_gold, reward_items)`

**`resources/quests/quest_a.tres`** — id: `quest_a`, no prerequisites, objective "Collect 5 herbs", reward 100 gold
**`resources/quests/quest_b.tres`** — id: `quest_b`, prerequisite `quest_a`, objective "Defeat 3 wolves", reward 200 gold + iron_sword
**`resources/quests/quest_c.tres`** — id: `quest_c`, prerequisite `quest_b`, objectives "Defeat the dragon" + "Retrieve the treasure", reward 500 gold + dragon_scale + golden_crown

**`project.godot`** — registers `QuestManager` as autoload singleton at `res://autoloads/QuestManager.gd`

All tests passed: quest loading, prerequisite chains, start/progress/complete lifecycle, signal emissions, and progress capping behavior verified.
